title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East  (Late Show) on 1970-05-15
lineage: 10 inch 1/2 track Master Reels @ 7.5 ips > Revox A700 > Alesis Masterlink ML 9600 > CD

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a marathon 1970 double‑bill, with Pigpen’s organ front‑and‑center and an all‑day run of classics like Attics, Cold Jordan, The Rub and a monster Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board (SBD) source that most listeners describe as crisp and well‑balanced, though the early acoustic portion suffers from a missing right channel and occasional vocal level spikes. Musically the show is legendary – two full Dead sets plus New Riders, highlighted by rare Attics, an unforgettable Cold Jordan, a searing The Rub, a monster Other One and multiple fire‑breathing Dark Stars. The flow of the double‑show marathon is praised despite its length, making it a must‑listen for any 1970 enthusiast.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, the vast majority are 4–5 stars and rave about both performance and sound quality; only a few note minor mix problems, so the combined show‑plus‑recording score lands in the excellent range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Minimal hiss, clear mix and good stereo separation; early acoustic set has right‑channel dropouts and fades, vocals a bit high, and a reel‑change gap in the second set that was patched from other sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon double‑bill with two acoustic sets, two electric sets and New Riders sandwiched in between; the length is massive but reviewers feel the pacing stays exciting throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his soaring guitar tone, especially on Attics and the Other One ('game on' vibe).
band_member_comments.Phil: Occasionally hard to hear in parts of the recording; otherwise solid bass foundation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for sitting in on Mama Tried, Sawmill and delivering strong rhythm/vocal work.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (Billiam) gets a lively intro; Mickey's brush work is highlighted during acoustic numbers.
